title: Check!
summary: When the king is under attack, you must respond right away.

steps.text: When a piece attacks the king, we say the king is in CHECK. You must get out of check right away — by moving the king, blocking the attack, or capturing the attacking piece.

steps.prompt: Your king is in check from the rook! Move him to safety, off the e-file.
steps.successText: Phew — safe! You escaped the check.
steps.retryText: The rook attacks the whole e-file — step off it to escape.

steps.prompt: You can also get out of check by BLOCKING the attack! Move your bishop to e5 to block the rook's path.
steps.successText: Great blocking move! The rook can't reach your king now.
steps.retryText: Put your bishop right in the rook's path — try e5.

steps.prompt: This time, you can capture the checking piece! Slide your queen down to capture the rook on e2.
steps.retryText: Your queen can reach the checking rook — try capturing it on e2.

steps.text: So remember the three ways to escape check: move your king to safety, block the attack with another piece, or capture the attacking piece. Next: what happens when NONE of these are possible? That's called checkmate!
